notes: SCOPE: strictly the Home/Decor department (Category/Department facets 'Home Decor', 'Lighting', and the tabletop/glassware part of 'Kitchen & Dining'), not the whole site - same discipline as Target Home/Bed Bath & Beyond precedent. ACCESS: kohls.com is behind Akamai Bot Manager with a behavioral JS sensor challenge on every catalog/product page and even on the mapps.kohls.com browse API and the live robots.txt (which itself 403s: 'Access Denied ... errors.edgesuite.net'). Historical robots.txt recovered via Wayback (2024 snapshot) has no ClaudeBot-specific disallow, only generic crawl-trap rules (search, checkout, myaccount, sortfilter params) and Baiduspider block - no policy issue found. Route 1 (direct) and Route 5 (WebFetch) both 403 immediately. Route 3 (r.jina.ai) was globally Cloudflare-challenged from this workstation for the entire session (verified against https://example.com too, not kohls-specific - shared-pool contention per project memory). Route 4 (translate.goog / translate.google.com) returned Google's own HTTP 429 /sorry captcha on every attempt across multiple languages and both frontends, for the whole session. Route 2 (curl_cffi impersonation) was brute-forced across the FULL 42-profile BrowserType set available in this venv, repeated in 3 separate sweeps at ~2s spacing: attempt 1 on /catalog/wall-decor-home-decor.jsp got exactly ONE hit (safari260_ios, real 1.84MB page); immediately re-using that same profile succeeded ONE more time on /catalog.jsp?CN=Department:Home Decor (2.48MB); a third sweep (different URL, decorative-accents-home-decor.jsp) then failed on all 42 profiles including the previously-good safari260_ios, and a 4th sweep on Department:Lighting after a 90s cooldown also failed 42/42 - matching this project's established Crate & Barrel precedent (c58.json) where the workstation IP goes 'hot' after a couple of successful loads and the block survives quiet periods. Side doors: /sitemap.xml and all 6 /sitemap_catalog_N.xml + 16 /sitemap_product_N.xml files (38k+ URLs) are NOT Akamai-protected and were fetched cleanly - they confirmed the live Category/Product facet taxonomy (Category:Wall Decor, Decorative Accents, Candles, Picture Frames & Photo Albums, Rugs, Window Treatments, Artificial Flowers & Plants, Decorative Pillows & Chair Pads, Slipcovers & Furniture Protectors under Department:Home Decor; Category:Dinnerware & Serveware, Drinkware & Glassware under Department:Kitchen & Dining; Curtain Rods & Hardware under Category:Window Treatments) but carry NO product counts (they are just facet-combo URLs). The 2 successful live loads captured Kohl's own server-rendered facet JSON (an Astro/React 'Filters' island prop blob with dimensions/dimensionValues/productCount fields, i.e. the exact number the site's own filter panel and result grid show) rather than a raw platform total, so it is the empirically-correct field per Rule 1, but pagination/offset boundary-checking was not possible - each successful page load was a rare, costly event, not a repeatable resource. COUNTS OBTAINED (both from the 2 successful loads): Department:Home Decor top Category facet panel gave Candles 5,875 (excluded from qty - mixed scented/unscented roll-up, titles could not be inspected), Lighting(tag) 8,631, Rugs 14,372 (excluded - rugs), Window Treatments 4,860 (excluded - curtains/blinds, except the Curtain Rods & Hardware sub-facet which is in scope per brief but its own count is inaccessible), Decorative Accents 23,061, Wall Decor 33,724/33,725 (two reads 1 apart, both from the same page - treated as the live count, minor server-side flicker). The Wall Decor page's own 'Product' sub-facet gave a full breakdown (14 leaf types, sum 33,019 vs the page total ~33,725 - the ~700 gap is almost certainly items with no Product-level facet tag, not a scoping error) - ALL 14 types are decor product types (Art/wall art, Chalkboards, Clocks, Display Ledges, Growth Charts, Hanging Letters, Light Up Signs, Mirrors, Other Wall Decor, Photo Boards, Tapestries, Wall Accents, Wall Decals, Wall Hooks) so the whole Wall Decor category was kept in scope per Rule 0 (wall art, mirrors, clocks, decorative hooks are all explicitly in-brief). EXCLUDED per brief and not itemized: Rugs, Window Treatments (bulk), Artificial Flowers & Plants, Decorative Pillows & Chair Pads, Slipcovers & Furniture Protectors, and the Occasion:Christmas/Easter/Fall seasonal-decor facets seen on the same Category panel (Holiday & Gift exclusion). NOT REACHED at all (taxonomy confirmed live via sitemap, but zero successful page loads so qty is null+flagged): Picture Frames & Photo Albums, Kitchen & Dining's Dinnerware & Serveware and Drinkware & Glassware (tableware/glassware, in scope per brief), the standalone Department:Lighting node with its likely Room-based sub-tree (Rule 0.1 could not be executed - only the Category:Lighting-tagged-under-Home-Decor subset (8,631) was captured, which may not equal the full lighting catalogue), and Curtain Rods & Hardware. Given the large fraction of null+flagged qty against a modest number of fully-resolved leaves, status is 'partial' per this project's convention (S.N. 86/97/118/191 precedent), not 'ok'.
